descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Securitatea computerelor și a rețelelor
REVELSI is a global cybersecurity, AI, software, and infrastructure services organization. We work with worldwide enterprises to design, build, secure, and operate the systems their business depends on.
 Our top priority is safeguarding the fast-evolving global infrastructures and technologies.
 We integrate cybersecurity into infrastructure development and operational processes, alongside software development and AI-driven products, to proactively stay at the leading edge of industry advancements.
 REVELSI TEAM 
 At REVELSI , we combine deep technical expertise with a Silicon Valley-inspired mindset: agile, innovative, and collaborative.
 We’re a collaborative team that values performance and a positive work environment. We are committed to delivering high-quality results, supporting each other, and fostering a professional and friendly atmosphere.
 We’re looking for a team player with specialized skills, ready to make an impact alongside experts in cybersecurity, network design, architecture, AI & software development, and IT management.
 You’ll collaborate with experienced IT (Security) professionals, expand your skills, and enjoy the journey in a team that embraces challenges with energy and enthusiasm . 
 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY 
Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating security checks early in the development lifecycle and ensuring compliance with quality standards
Automate security-related tasks, including resource deployment, scanning, validation, reporting, and policy enforcement
Support secure Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices by integrating scanning and policy-as-code into delivery workflows
Enhance container security through image scanning, hardening, runtime controls, and improving Kubernetes security posture
Operate and manage Kubernetes clusters end-to-end, including upgrades, scaling, networking, and troubleshooting activities
Implement and enforce Kubernetes security best practices, including RBAC, network policies, admission controls, and secure service mesh configurations
Support secure network design by implementing controlled access patterns and collaborating with infrastructure and networking teams on segmentation
Contribute to monitoring and incident response readiness by improving logging, alerting, and overall system visibility
 YOUR PROFILE 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (Master’s degree is a plus). Relevant certifications such as Security+, Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-500, SC-300), or Kubernetes certifications (CKA/CKS) are nice to have
Around 2+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering, with hands-on work in CI/CD environments
Solid knowledge of Azure cloud services, with focus on networking, identity and access management, monitoring, and encryption (exposure to AWS or GCP is a plus)
Experience with Entra ID and hybrid identity concepts, including tenants, app registrations, service principals, and access management
Good understanding of authentication and authorization protocols such as OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, and JWT
Experience working with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including securing workflows, approvals, and service connections
Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible, including modular design and security scanning practices
Hands-on experience administering Kubernetes/AKS environments, including networking, scaling, and troubleshooting
Strong scripting and automation skills using languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
Good understanding of Git workflows, including branching strategies and pull request management
Ability to define standards, create documentation, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement
Strong ownership mindset, with focus on continuous improvement and delivering measurable results
Willing to work from Monday to Friday between 12:00 and 21:00 with 1 hour lunch break, in a hybrid system (4 days from our office)
 WE VALUE OUR EMPLOYEES: 
 At REVELSI , we create an environment that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance:
Private healthcare & medical insurance
Private dental services
Meal vouchers
Referral bonus program
Learning & development opportunities
Team buildings & events
Pizza day and free drinks at the office
Seasonal gifts (Christmas / Easter)
21 days PTO, increasing up to 25 based on seniority
 Ready to Join Us?
 Click “Apply” and let’s get started!
 Every day is an opportunity to grow and go beyond our limits! We embrace challenges and succeed together as a team—because great things happen when we collaborate.
